vocabulary.name: EOD Historical Data API Vocabulary
vocabulary.description: Domain vocabulary for the EODHD Financial Data API covering financial market data, historical prices, fundamentals, and analytics

terms.definition: End-of-Day — the final official price and volume data for a security recorded after market close
Open, High, Low, Close, Volume — the five standard data points recorded for each trading session
Closing price adjusted retroactively for corporate actions such as stock splits and dividends to produce a continuous time series
Unique alphabetic abbreviation used to identify a publicly traded company or financial instrument on an exchange, e.g. AAPL.US
Short identifier for a stock exchange, e.g. US (NYSE/NASDAQ), LSE, F (Frankfurt), T (Tokyo)
International Securities Identification Number — a 12-character alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies a security globally
Committee on Uniform Security Identification Procedures — a 9-character alphanumeric code used to identify securities in the US and Canada
Financial statement data for a company including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements, typically sourced from SEC filings
Price data recorded at sub-daily intervals (1min, 5min, 1h) during active trading sessions
The complete list of call and put option contracts available for a given underlying security across all expiration dates and strike prices
Measures of sensitivity of an options contract price to various factors: Delta (underlying price), Gamma (delta rate), Theta (time), Vega (volatility), Rho (interest rate)
The market's forecast of a likely movement in a security's price, derived from options pricing
Mathematical calculations based on price and volume data used to forecast price movements, e.g. SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands
Country-level economic statistics such as GDP, inflation rate, unemployment, and trade balance
A purchase or sale of company stock by a corporate officer, director, or holder of more than 10% of the company's shares, as reported to the SEC on Form 4
Environmental, Social, and Governance — a framework for evaluating a company's sustainability and ethical practices
Query parameter used to authenticate requests to the EODHD API
A numerical score indicating the emotional tone (positive/negative/neutral) of financial news articles related to a security or market
A tool that filters securities based on specified fundamental, technical, or market criteria
Real-time streaming data protocol available at wss://ws.eodhistoricaldata.com/ws for live market price updates
